# OneMira AI — Official Developer & Buyer Hub (onemira-space.github.io)

> OneMira C1 ($99, $0/month subscription) is a standalone AI voice recorder and local context system with ✨ Local AI, Works Standalone capture, 🗣️ 99-language Speaker ID, Zero Cloud upload, and 38 MCP tools for Claude Code, Cursor, and Obsidian.
